$comment: Lucina design tokens: the one source of the look of every Lucina app (iOS, web, Android, macOS, Windows). Taken from the iOS Weight, Settings and Chat tabs, which the owner picked as the house style on 2026-10-24. Edit here, then run tools/design-tokens (see design/README.md); never edit the generated files.
name: Lucina

color.$comment: Each colour has a dark and a light value. Dark is the default look. `ios` names the UIKit system colour the iOS app uses instead of the hex, so Increase Contrast and the system's own tuning still apply; the hex is what that colour resolves to.

chatBg.$comment: Chat screen background: the owner's dark royal blue (2026-10-27). Same in both modes; bubbles sit on it as cards.

cardRaised.$comment: Something inside a card (a chip, a nested tile).

field.$comment: Text fields, search bars, pill inputs, unselected chips.

accent.$comment: Periwinkle from the Lucina icon: tint, icons, the chart line, the selected tab.

accentFill.$comment: Filled surfaces under white text (buttons, the user's chat bubble): 6.1:1 under white.

glass.$comment: Frosted glass (owner, 2026-10-28, the Android blur): surfaces that float over content (rail, title bar, toolbars, sheets, popovers, composer, the phone tab bar), never dense cards or lists. Blurred 24 px, saturated 1.4 (web --glass-blur; iOS .ultraThinMaterial). 60% so primary text keeps WCAG AA even over a busy page.

glassHighlight.$comment: 1 px inner highlight along the top edge.

glassFallback.$comment: Solid glass: no backdrop blur, reduced transparency, or over the live desktop or a playing video.

font.$comment: System font everywhere (SF Pro on Apple, Segoe UI Variable on Windows, Roboto on Android). Sizes in points (iOS Dynamic Type defaults at Large); web uses px = pt.
font.family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif
font.familyMono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

title2.$comment: Big value in a stat card.

caption.$comment: Stat card label with its icon.

chart.$comment: The Weight tab's Tendens chart: accent line over faint points, dashed goal rule, light grid.

tabBar.$comment: Floating glass tab bar (iOS 26 system tab bar; on the web a blurred capsule dock). The active tab is the accent colour on a soft accent pill.
